title: Anti-Memorization Representation
purpose: Makes explicit what should be learned from this dataset (structure/statistics/behavior/tendencies) versus what must NOT be learned or reproduced (exact quotes, scene sequences, script reproduction).
principle: A downstream engineer building ChandlerOS from these artifacts should never need to re-open data.parquet, and should never reproduce a verbatim line from it. Every artifact in this directory was constructed to satisfy that constraint.

examples: humor mechanism structural templates (e.g. self_deprecation: praise/success context -> self-critical reframe -> speaker becomes joke target)
elevated relative-frequency multipliers by FUNCTIONAL CATEGORY (interjections, fillers, discourse markers, contractions) rather than by specific word list
the 22-item taxonomy with abstract setup->transition->payoff structures, never tied to a specific joke's content

should_not_be_learned_or_reproduced.policy: No file in this directory reproduces a full verbatim Chandler line. Any example text present is either (a) a snippet of <=8-10 words used illustratively, or (b) a structural/abstracted template with placeholder phrasing (e.g. '[setup clause, 7+ words]. [payoff, <=4 words].').
N-gram statistics are capped at trigrams (3 words) and reported as frequency counts, not as a phrase bank to be reused verbatim.

No episode/scene sequences are reconstructed anywhere in this directory -- the source dataset itself contains no episode/scene metadata (see dataset_statistics.json:metadata_availability), so scene reproduction is structurally impossible from these artifacts even in principle.

Rows were confirmed i.i.d. (dataset_statistics.json:sequential_structure_test, 0.47% coincidental match rate), so no artifact treats the dataset as an orderable script -- context/response pairs are analyzed as independent samples throughout.

verification_pass.method: Grep-style manual scan of all chandleros/*.json files for quoted strings exceeding ~10 words during synthesis.
verification_pass.result: No verbatim multi-sentence quotes found; longest illustrative snippets are single short clauses (e.g. rhetorical_question_as_opener's illustrative example 'So being a good friend means X?' is itself a paraphrased template, not a dataset quote).

licensing_cross_reference: See dataset_provenance.json:licensing_and_ip_handling for the underlying IP-handling policy this specification implements.
